# 0. Section name as it appears in the spec

`section` is the section's number, in quotes, exactly as other docs, code comments, tests and issues cite it ("6.8"). A
section number never changes and always resolves to one page. A number that is dropped is not reused.

The heading keeps the number. A subsection keeps its own number in its heading ("## 6.8 Compatibility") so a citation
such as `SPEC 6.8` finds it on this page. Add an unnumbered `###` subheading inside a section for anything new.

State what the product must do, in sentences that can be tested. Say "must" for a requirement, and say which test or
mockup shows it when there is one.

## 0.1 Subsection name

The requirement.
